2. Hosting Platforms
props.summary: We are using Amazon Web Services as our hosting provider of choice. This conforms to the GDS Tech Forum Hosting Guide. We will initially be using the eu-west-1 region, Ireland. This region has 3 availability zones and also contains the GDS PaaS which will allow easier sharing and peering.
